# RETALLY

> Independent freight audit and recovery service for finance, accounts-payable, transportation and logistics teams.

## Offer
- $0-upfront initial freight recovery audit.
- Reviews a bounded historical freight population for supportable billing discrepancies.
- Common review areas include duplicate freight charges, rate mismatches, fuel, accessorials, LTL adjustments, parcel charges and settlement/credit mismatches.
- Recovery work begins only after separate authorization.
- Fees apply only to eligible funds actually recovered under the engagement.
- Recovery is not guaranteed.
